review_kind: One observed ChatGPT collaboration review; not a benchmark or human verdict
scope: Five independent supplied snippets, judged solely against input/CONTRACT.md
method: Source inspection plus 34 observed local Python executions. Snippets executed independently without modification.

findings.title: Equality at EUR 5,000 enters the wrong queue
findings.behavior: The <= comparison includes the threshold in STANDARD_QUEUE/BELOW_LIMIT. The contract requires equality to take HUMAN_REVIEW/AT_OR_ABOVE_LIMIT.
findings.recommended_change: Use amount < THRESHOLD_EUR for the standard-queue branch.

unknowns: Execution sampled boundary and invalid values; did not exhaust all strings.

cases.rationale: The strict less-than comparison implements the required boundary; parse failures, nonfinite values and nonpositive values are rejected; the policy identity is v1.
unknowns: No exhaustive lexical or execution-environment exploration was performed; inputs outside strings are excluded by contract.

findings.title: A standard queue is falsely presented as payment authorization
findings.behavior: The expression is True for STANDARD_QUEUE. The presenter must always add payment_authorized=False.
findings.recommended_change: Set payment_authorized to the literal False for every accepted decision.
findings.evidence: Observed for both v1 and v2 in EXECUTION_OBSERVATIONS.json.

cases.rationale: The comprehension copies exactly the three required values, preserving historical and new policy identities, and assigns the literal False to payment_authorized. No particular copying style is required.
unknowns: No claims are made about inputs lacking required keys or arbitrary custom object behaviors outside the exercise.

findings.title: The presenter relabels new v2 decisions as v1
findings.behavior: A fixed BR-001/v1 value overwrites the supplied policy identity, violating exact preservation.
findings.recommended_change: Use decision["policy_version"] as the output policy_version.
findings.evidence: All three executed v2 examples were relabeled v1 in EXECUTION_OBSERVATIONS.json.

limitations: Single observed AI review, without a human verdict or independent reference inspection.
Finite sample executions support the findings; they are not an exhaustive test suite.
Decimal string lexical grammar is not further specified in the supplied contract; no additional grammar rules were invented.
The cases are independent; no incompatibility between assess return objects and present input mappings is alleged.
